nodes.label: DAVE: Distribution-aware Attribution via ViT Gradient Decomposition
nodes.author: Adam Wróbel, Siddhartha Gairola, Jacek Tabor, Bernt Schiele, Bartosz Zieliński, Dawid Rymarczyk
nodes.rationale: Proposes a mathematically grounded attribution method for Vision Transformers that decomposes input gradients to isolate stable, locally equivariant components while suppressing architecture-induced artifacts.

nodes.label: Effective Transformation Extraction
nodes.rationale: Core technical contribution: decomposes layer derivatives into effective transformation (direct input-output action) and operator variation (sensitivity to input changes), retaining only the former to avoid amplifying high-frequency instabilities.

nodes.label: Reynolds-Inspired Equivariant Filtering
nodes.rationale: Suppresses architecture-induced patterns (patch-grid artifacts) by averaging effective transformations over local neighborhoods of spatial transformations, isolating components that vary consistently under small perturbations.

nodes.label: Low-Pass Filtering via Stochastic Averaging
nodes.rationale: Applies Gaussian smoothing to equivariant effective transformation to attenuate high-frequency artifacts while preserving stable attribution signals, equivalent to convolution with smoothing kernel.

nodes.label: Patch Embeddings
nodes.rationale: ViT architectural component that introduces structured grid-like artifacts in gradient-based attributions; DAVE targets suppression of these artifacts.

nodes.label: Attention Routing
nodes.rationale: ViT mechanism that contributes to architecture-induced artifacts in attribution maps; DAVE's equivariant filtering specifically addresses attention-induced patterns.

nodes.label: B-cos Networks (Inherently Interpretable)
nodes.rationale: Baseline for comparison; DAVE improves upon inherent B-cos explanations by producing sharper, more object-aligned attributions.

nodes.label: GridPG (Grid Pointing Game) Localization Metric
nodes.rationale: Evaluation metric measuring whether maximally attributed location falls inside ground-truth object region; DAVE achieves 60.19% on ViT-B/16, improving over baselines.

nodes.label: EnergyPG (Energy Pointing Game) Localization Metric
nodes.rationale: Evaluation metric measuring fraction of attribution mass contained inside ground-truth bounding box; DAVE achieves 82.43% on DeiT-III-B/16.

nodes.label: Pixel Deletion Faithfulness Metric
nodes.rationale: Evaluates stability of attributions by progressively removing pixels in order of increasing attribution and tracking target-class probability; DAVE yields flattest curves.
